correctness.rationale: Both graph update matrices are derived directly from their distinct-neighbour lists. On M_2n the ring multiplier is z^{-1}(1+z²+z^{n+1}); its only possible root on z^{2n}+1 satisfies the primitive-cube relation, while derivative and Hasse derivative give exact multiplicity 1 (even n) or 2 (odd n). On the prism B²=(Phi_3/z)²I and its local Smith factors are (1,Phi_3²). These prove, for every n, all kernel dimensions, transient bounds, recurrent dimensions and fibre sizes. Direct bitset matrix rank verification for n=3..128 and independent scalar state enumeration for n=3..9 reproduced all proposed quantities. All dimensions, boundaries, timing quantifiers and the phase-fibre definition are explicit.

value.rationale: An n-rung cubic ladder and the same ladder with one crossed seam are a canonical controlled comparison of boundary topology under a fixed local rule. The exact infinite-family law shows the twist preserves the number of recurrent states and uniform eventual-phase fibre size, yet changes maximum entrance time from 2 to 1 for odd n and multiplies it by 2 for even n divisible by 3. It therefore isolates a structural, quantitatively sharp boundary effect invisible from attractor counts, including unbounded two-adic delays and complete entrance-depth distributions. The motivator is not arbitrary parameter slicing or recomputation of a pre-existing table.
